message.content:
Based on the search results, I can estimate how many times the average human blinks in a lifetime.

## Key Variables

**Blink Rate:**
- Most adults blink about **14-20 times per minute** during normal activity
- Cleveland Clinic cites **14-17 times per minute**
- All About Vision cites **15 times per minute** for teens/adults
- MDPI research paper notes normal activity averages **17 blinks per minute**, with a range of 6-30

**Daily Blink Count:**
- At 15-20 blinks/minute × 16 waking hours: **14,400-19,200 blinks per day** (Cleveland Clinic, Lens.com)
- All About Vision calculates: **21,600 blinks per day** (using full 24 hours)
- Most sources account for sleep time, giving **~14,400-21,600 blinks/day**

**Annual Blink Count:**
- All About Vision: ~**7.8 million blinks per year**

**Average Lifespan:**
- WHO global average: approximately **72 years**
- Many estimates use **70-80 years**

## Lifetime Estimate Calculation

Using the most commonly cited figures:
- **15 blinks/minute** × **960 minutes awake/day** (16 hours) = **14,400 blinks/day**
- **14,400 blinks/day** × **365.25 days/year** ≈ **5.26 million blinks/year**
- **5.26 million blinks/year** × **72 years** ≈ **379 million blinks/lifetime**

Or using All About Vision's methodology:
- **21,600 blinks/day** × **365 days** = ~**7.88 million/year**
- **7.88 million/year** × ~**79 years** = **621.5 million blinks/lifetime**

## Reasonable Estimate Range

The sources provide a wide range due to different assumptions:
- **~300-440 million blinks** (using conservative estimates: 13-17 blinks/min, 16 hours awake, 72-year lifespan)
- **~620 million blinks** (using 15 blinks/min across all 24 hours, ~79-year lifespan)

A **reasonable middle estimate** would be approximately **400-500 million blinks in a lifetime**, or roughly **half a billion blinks**. If we use the more common conservative approach (accounting for sleep and using 14-17 blinks/minute), the estimate is closer to **300-400 million blinks**.

Sources:
1. https://www.allaboutvision.com/eye-care/eye-anatomy/how-many-times-we-blink-per-day/
2. https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/blinking
3. https://www.lens.com/questions-answered/how-many-blinks-does-the-average-person-do-a-day/
4. https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/11/19/3183
5. https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12280v2
6. https://wellwisp.com/how-many-times-should-you-blink-per-minute/
7. https://manchesterbedfordeyecare.com/2025/03/26/blinking-more-important-than-you-think/
8. https://www.thedailyjagran.com/did-you-know/do-you-know-how-many-times-an-average-person-blinks-per-day-10263091
9. https://seemaeye.com/how-often-should-you-blink-train-your-eyes-to-blink-naturally-again/
10. https://eyelasikaustin.com/how-many-times-a-day-do-you-blink-your-eyes/
